verdict.rationale: Name.com documents a public Core API with HTTP Basic auth and token issuance, plus reference endpoints for domain availability, registration, DNS records, transfers, email forwarding, WHOIS privacy, TLD pricing and webhooks. It also offers a sandbox environment and official TypeScript/Go/PHP SDKs, and a probe confirmed the docs are live and machine-readable via llms.txt. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented, and a Python SDK (listed only as coming soon).
